# Exact punctuation-, accent-, and repetition-tolerant title signatures.
def exact_normalized_title(r):
    import re
    import unicodedata
    import hashlib

    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", r.get("title", "") or "")
    s = "".join(c for c in s if not unicodedata.combining(c)).lower()
    words = re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", s)
    collapsed = []
    for w in words:
        if not collapsed or collapsed[-1] != w:
            collapsed.append(w)
    if not collapsed:
        return []
    value = " ".join(collapsed)
    return ["xt:" + hashlib.blake2s(value.encode(), digest_size=8).hexdigest()]


# Product-code, digit-sequence, capacity, and compound identifier anchors from every attribute.
def identifier_and_quantity_anchors(r):
    import re
    import unicodedata

    text = " ".join((r.get(a, "") or "") for a in ("title", "brand", "price", "description"))
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", text)
    text = "".join(c for c in text if not unicodedata.combining(c)).lower()
    keys = set()

    chunks = re.findall(r"[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._/+:-]*", text)
    for raw in chunks:
        compact = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", raw)
        if len(compact) >= 4 and re.search(r"[a-z]", compact) and re.search(r"\d", compact):
            keys.add("id:" + compact[:32])
        for digits in re.findall(r"\d{4,}", compact):
            keys.add("dn:" + digits[:20])

    unit_pat = r"(?:[kmgtpe]?b|hz|mhz|ghz|rpm|mm|cm|inch|inches|pin|core|mp|mah|w)"
    for m in re.finditer(r"(?<!\d)(\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)\s*(" + unit_pat + r")\b", text):
        number = m.group(1).replace(",", ".").lstrip("0") or "0"
        unit = m.group(2)
        keys.add("qu:" + number + unit)
        keys.add("qn:" + number)

    for m in re.finditer(r"[/_-](\d{1,3})(?!\d)", text):
        keys.add("qn:" + str(int(m.group(1))))

    return sorted(keys)[:32]


# Lexical anchors plus short character skeletons tolerate omitted brands, translations, and minor spelling changes.
def lexical_and_character_anchors(r):
    import re
    import unicodedata

    text = " ".join((r.get(a, "") or "") for a in ("title", "brand"))
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", text)
    text = "".join(c for c in text if not unicodedata.combining(c)).lower()
    words = re.findall(r"[a-z]{3,}", text)
    keys = set()

    for word in words[:24]:
        if len(word) >= 4:
            keys.add("wd:" + word[:24])
        if len(word) >= 6:
            keys.add("p3:" + word[:3])
            consonants = re.sub(r"[aeiouy]", "", word)
            if len(consonants) >= 4:
                keys.add("cs:" + consonants[:8])

    return sorted(keys)


# Missing-attribute and numeric-shape fallbacks cover sparse listings and compound values with no reliable lexical bridge.
def sparse_and_compound_fallbacks(r):
    import re
    import unicodedata

    title = r.get("title", "") or ""
    brand = r.get("brand", "") or ""
    price = r.get("price", "") or ""
    description = r.get("description", "") or ""
    keys = []

    if title and not price.strip() and not description.strip():
        keys.append("fb:bare-listing")

    text = " ".join((title, brand, price))
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", text)
    text = "".join(c for c in text if not unicodedata.combining(c)).lower()

    for integer, fraction in re.findall(r"(?<!\d)(\d+)[.,](\d{2})(?!\d)", text):
        if len(set(integer + fraction)) == 1:
            keys.append("fb:repeated-decimal")
            break

    tokens = re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", text)
    if tokens and len(set(tokens)) < len(tokens):
        keys.append("fb:repeated-token")

    if title and not brand.strip() and not price.strip() and not description.strip():
        keys.append("fb:title-only")

    return sorted(set(keys))


SCHEMES = {
    "exact_normalized_title": exact_normalized_title,
    "identifier_and_quantity_anchors": identifier_and_quantity_anchors,
    "lexical_and_character_anchors": lexical_and_character_anchors,
    "sparse_and_compound_fallbacks": sparse_and_compound_fallbacks,
}
